reactions: [Hacker News] That is one of the best assurances that we have these days, that is how bad is the situation.

[Hacker News] Your latter point belies the former: The the trade-off is only worth it if the data centers are used for purposes that benefit humanity. As yet, all we've seen them used for is wealth consolidation (through labor force reduction), mass surveillance, hacking, and other antisocial behaviors. There's no reason to believe those won't persist as the profit-maximizing use cases.

[Hacker News] While interesting, it reminds me of all the headlines over the years about governments who were switching off of Microsoft Office to OpenOffice/LibreOffice. Needless to say Microsoft didn't close up shop.

[Hacker News] They've already established and accepted that level of trust with Microsoft and deemed it acceptable. In this particular case of Copilot vs OpenAI vs Anthropic, the question is whether OpenAI or Anthropic are higher trust than Microsoft when it comes to AI, data handling/retention, etc.
[Hacker News] That doesn’t change my argument. I’m not saying it won’t happen, I’m saying it’s outweighed for most by other concerns.
[Hacker News] Something like this already happened, many times.
